canonical_identity: CGX = FileSpace; Cognigrex.cgx is parent; DataSpace is permissioned exchange, not a second master
host: Existing LS GO application and existing LS GO bridge, not new reviewer service
visitor_identity: Invitation link possession is a bounded enrollment proof, not verified legal identity; future external identity provider needs owner approval

visitor_lenses.name: Evidence
visitor_lenses.scope: public provenance, citations, limitations, methodological review

visitor_event: LS-GO-CGX-VISITOR/0.1 receipt in existing DB; promote to CGX DBR only on owner accepted reconciliation
generation: Default PENDING_PUBLIC_SAFE_RESOLVER. An already-approved public projection may be returned only through ls_go_public_projection_contract.json; no on-demand AI/CAD generation, private source discovery, measurement inference or authority promotion.
admission_requirements: owner approved migration and signing key
deny static asset exposures per LS GO issue 158
frontdoor: Squarespace /cgx orientation remains separate and public read-only

public_projection_adapter.authority: derived Public projection only; never canonical/source authority
public_projection_adapter.source: owner-configured local manifest reference outside dist-review

privacy_admission.authority: Owner policy acceptance is external to code; LS GO verifies only the presence of an explicit bounded acceptance reference.
required_for_new_admission: LIGHTSPEED_VISITOR_PRIVACY_POLICY_REF is a bounded owner-policy: reference or safe HTTPS reference
privacy_admission.admission_effect: New invite issuance and invite redemption are held when the acceptance reference is absent or invalid.
privacy_admission.existing_reviewer_safety: Existing valid sessions continue under the ordinary storage/signing gate so profile access, privacy requests, consent withdrawal, logout, owner revocation and owner audit are not disabled by an admission hold.
privacy_admission.public_capabilities: Expose only admission_enabled and privacy policy state; never expose the policy reference itself.

reusable_surface_window.backend: Existing LS GO FastAPI bridge: POST /api/v1/visitor/surface
reusable_surface_window.identity: Exact CGX Object_ID supplied by caller; only owner-admitted public manifest is served

surfaces.evidence: released evidence stage/limits/citations; no private sources
surfaces.model: approved HTTPS representation URL metadata only; user initiated navigation
surfaces.map: SURFACE_NOT_RELEASED until owner-signed spatial projection exists
surfaces.timeline: SURFACE_NOT_RELEASED until bitemporal source/epoch proof exists

reusable_surface_window.historical_selector: requested_valid_at / requested_recorded_at returns 409 until admitted bitemporal public manifest
reusable_surface_window.public_route_rule: optional visual mount to approved reviewer origin only; public route never receives invite token or session secret; legacy content remains unchanged
secure_host_requirements: approved HTTPS origin and exact reverse-proxy route permit-list
CSP frame-ancestors limited to approved web embedding origins
distinct public-only artifact, never private operator dist
forbidden: no new server, database, canonical root or compute scheduler
no client embed API key/visitor session/invite
no private source or raw geometry in static bundle
no public claim upgrade or machine execution
